question: Fresh test of the push rule. Growing: blocks in shared columns whose bottom reaches the old end, and any block whose top is past it, all by the growth, no chains. Shrinking: the same test against the new end, by the fall, the highest stopping at the new end. Rows: a rise in need takes spare rows first, a fall gives up the same number. Section takes the change of its lowest block. First undo lets rows fall. Varied: sizes, starts, types (Shape, Image by its corner, Button, Line), paste, Heading, Enter, phone, undo and redo.
